# Recorded draft fixtures

These Phase 1b replies were recorded from real generation. On 2026-10-12, the
Phase 1b.2 review follow-up added quantity/frame metadata offline for the new draft
format; they were not regenerated. Original expressions, results and teaching text
are preserved. Closed-surface flux uses its intrinsic outward-normal scalar
definition; field strengths, areas and lengths are magnitudes. These fixtures
do not contain directed component examples; the offline sign regression tests do.

The renderer's lesson contract and golden lesson fixtures remain unchanged.
